name: mseo-ai-web
description: MSEO AI & Web static publishing site

scripts.build: npm run build:catalog && npm run build:css
scripts.validate: npm run build:catalog && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs && node scripts/validate-site.mjs

scripts.test: npm run check:js && npm run validate
